entries.title: Process-Invariant Ring Amplifier
entries.desc: Ring amplifier in IHP SG13G2 with deadzone regulation for robust PVT performance, validated in a switched-capacitor amplifier.

entries.title: Two-Transistor Subthreshold Voltage Reference
entries.desc: An ultra-low power voltage reference using native NMOS subthreshold operation, achieving sub-picoWatt power.

entries.title: Low Dropout Voltage Regulator
entries.desc: LDO in SKY130 with integrated digital on-chip load for transient testing.

entries.title: Rail-to-Rail OTA
entries.desc: Folded-cascode OTA with complementary PMOS/NMOS differential pair for full rail-to-rail input swing.

entries.title: Fully Differential OTA
entries.desc: Two-stage fully differential OTA with buffer-based CM feedback for stable output common-mode level.

entries.title: Power-on Reset Circuit
entries.desc: Current comparator-based POR in SKY130 that asserts Enable at a defined VDD threshold across PVT corners.

entries.title: PVT Simulation Automation
entries.desc: Python framework for automated PVT corner sweeps in NGSpice with metric extraction and comparison plots.

entries.title: gm/ID Extraction — SKY130
entries.desc: gm/ID lookup tables and extraction scripts for SKY130 enabling structured design methodology with open-source tools.
